China.description: High urgency on domestic NEV parity (Li Auto, NIO, XPENG) & local software ecosystems.

Europe.description: High weight on BMW driving DNA, Autobahn acoustic refinement, and WLTP energy efficiency.

USA.description: High weight on public charging reliability (NACS), EPA highway range, and interior storage utility.

Global.description: Balanced global scorecard across volume, brand prestige, and technical complexity.

requirements.title: Integrated Rear Console Refrigerator (8.5L Dual-Mode Chilled/Heated Mini-Fridge)
requirements.smart_specification: Integrated rear center console compressor-refrigeration unit with 8.5L usable volume (capacity for two 0.75L wine bottles or four 330ml cans), achieving active pull-down cooling from 25°C to 4°C within ≤20 minutes, heating mode up to 50°C, operating at acoustic noise ≤36 dB(A), controllable via rear touch console and My BMW App.
acceptance_criteria: Usable volume ≥ 8.5 liters with dual champagne/can divider
Thermal pull-down from 25°C ambient to 4°C in ≤ 20 minutes
Acoustic noise ceiling ≤ 36 dB(A) during peak compressor cycle
Remote cabin pre-cooling scheduling via My BMW App and HarmonyOS NEXT widget

sources.citation: G60-0388: 'Rear passengers in executive trips expect cold beverages and better thigh support than currently provided in G68 standard seats.'
F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx (CN_EU_2025): G68 rear seat comfort lags flagship G70 by 0.86 satisfaction points in China.
Li Auto L8/L9 features standard dual-compressor 8.8L fridge (0°C–50°C) at RMB 339,800.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Chauffeur and rear executive passenger usage in Tier 1 China remains >45% for G68 long-wheelbase.
Packaging Constraint: Compressor unit must not compromise trunk golf bag load-through capacity (minimum 480L retained).

audit_trail.rationale: Derived from G68 rear cabin feedback and Li Auto L8 competitor packaging advantage in China.

requirements.title: DeepSeek/Alibaba LLM-Powered Natural Voice Assistant (≤300ms Latency)
requirements.smart_specification: BMW Operating System X in-vehicle conversational AI utilizing localized DeepSeek and Alibaba LLM models, delivering multi-turn natural language dialog with end-to-end cloud/edge response latency ≤300ms, multi-intent execution in Mandarin and Cantonese, and native integration with WeChat and Huawei HarmonyOS NEXT ecosystems.
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end voice intent execution latency ≤ 300 ms on 5G network
Complex multi-intent command success rate ≥ 96% in Mandarin and Cantonese dialects
Zero-latency edge fallback for cabin climate, windows, and seat adjustments without internet
Native WeChat voice messaging and destination sending via My BMW app

sources.citation: BMW Group Report 2025, p. 29: Chinese derivative of BMW OS X incorporates ~70% local software; LLM partnerships with DeepSeek and Alibaba established for natural voice interaction.
G60-0812: 'Voice assistant takes 2-3 seconds to understand Mandarin commands and struggles with complex navigation destinations.'
NIO NOMI AI & XPENG voice assistant achieve sub-300ms latency and 4-zone conversational tracking.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Local data residency and cloud compute compliance under Chinese automotive cybersecurity laws.
Conflict: Driver focus vs rich in-cabin conversational interruptions handled via localized AI gating.

audit_trail.rationale: Directly grounded in BMW 2025 Annual Report R&D strategy (p. 29) to eliminate conversational AI lag against Chinese NEVs.

requirements.title: Neue Klasse 800V High-Power Charging (10-80% in ≤15 min) with Smart Preconditioning
requirements.smart_specification: Neue Klasse 800V silicon-carbide (SiC) high-voltage platform supporting peak charging power ≥270 kW, achieving 10% to 80% state-of-charge replenishment in ≤15 minutes (adding ≥300 km in 10 minutes), with automated navigation-linked battery thermal conditioning bringing cells to optimal 32°C across -15°C to 45°C ambient temperatures.
acceptance_criteria: 10% to 80% DC fast-charging duration ≤ 15 minutes at 800V high-power dispensers
WLTP certified range ≥ 720 km (CLTC ≥ 800 km for China, EPA ≥ 420 miles for US)
Winter range degradation at -7°C ambient limited to ≤ 18% via high-efficiency heat pump
Automatic thermal preconditioning initiated upon navigation waypoint to fast charger

sources.citation: BMW Group Report 2025, p. 53: Neue Klasse 800V architecture and Gen-6 cylindrical cells debut to maximize charging curve and energy density.
G60-1204: 'In winter, public charging speed throttles significantly without automated high-power navigation preconditioning.'
XPENG G9 (800V SiC) and Porsche Taycan deliver 10-80% in 15-18 mins.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Rapid buildout of 800V liquid-cooled public charging networks across European highways and Tier 1/2 China.
Uncertainty: US rural charging infrastructure reliability mitigated by NACS Supercharger access.

audit_trail.rationale: Aligns with Neue Klasse platform strategic commitments and eliminates winter DC throttling complaints.

requirements.title: Dual-Laminated Acoustic Glazing & Active Aero Road-Noise Shielding
requirements.smart_specification: Standard dual-pane acoustic laminated glass on windshield and front/rear side windows combined with active underbody air management, achieving interior acoustic sound pressure level ≤61 dB(A) at 130 km/h and ≤65 dB(A) at 160 km/h on German Autobahn coarse asphalt surfaces.
acceptance_criteria: In-cabin sound level ≤ 61 dB(A) at steady 130 km/h cruise
In-cabin sound level ≤ 65 dB(A) at 160 km/h Autobahn cruise
High-frequency wind flutter around A-pillars and side mirrors reduced by ≥ 3 dB(A)
Standard equipment across all European 5 Series / i5 lines (unbundled from luxury packs)

sources.citation: G60-0419: 'Wind rustle around A-pillar and side mirrors noticeable on German Autobahn above 140 km/h.'
F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx: EU G60 acoustic comfort rating (8.31) trails Mercedes EQE with acoustic comfort pack (8.75).
G60_OptionList.PDF: Acoustic glazing (SA 3KA) currently locked behind expensive Innovation package.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Autobahn high-speed cruising remains a core buying factor for German fleet managers (>60% of European 5 Series sales).
Weight Penalty: Acoustic glass adds approximately 3.2 kg total curb weight, offset by Neue Klasse lightweight door structures.

audit_trail.rationale: Addresses significant Autobahn wind noise verbatims and closes the gap against Mercedes EQE acoustic package.

requirements.title: Tactile Haptic Quick-Access Control Bar & Steering Micro-Controllers
requirements.smart_specification: Driver-centric tactile control strip featuring customizable haptic confirmation beneath the BMW Panoramic Vision display, enabling blind tactile operation of temperature, defrost, hazard, and drive mode selection within ≤0.5 seconds eyes-off-road duration, supplemented by physical rotary thumbwheels on the steering wheel.
acceptance_criteria: Eyes-off-road duration for primary climate adjustment ≤ 0.5 seconds
Haptic actuation feedback latency ≤ 50 ms with distinct click simulation
Retention of physical rotary scroll wheels on steering wheel spokes
Compliance with Euro NCAP 2026 physical button safety assessment protocol

sources.citation: G60-0084: 'Adjusting climate controls and seat heating via touchscreen while driving fast is distracting and frustrating compared to previous generation buttons.'
G60-0931: 'Miss the physical iDrive rotary controller shortcut buttons on the highway.'
Euro NCAP 2026 guidelines penalizing vehicles that force core driving functions into screen submenus.

assumptions_uncertainties: Conflict Resolution: Reconciles European preference for tactile safety with modern minimalist glass cockpit styling.
Manufacturing: Module shared across Neue Klasse derivatives to minimize tooling overhead.

audit_trail.rationale: Direct response to overwhelming European customer feedback rejecting pure touch sub-menus for basic HVAC.

requirements.title: Native NACS Charge Inlet with Automated ISO 15118-20 Plug & Charge
requirements.smart_specification: Factory-integrated North American Charging Standard (NACS) charge port backed by ISO 15118-20 Plug & Charge automated encryption, establishing seamless high-speed charging session initiation across 15,000+ Tesla Supercharger dispensers and public networks in <5 seconds from plug insertion without third-party apps.
acceptance_criteria: Plug-to-session initiation time < 5 seconds at Tesla Supercharger V3/V4 dispensers
Full backward compatibility with CCS1 via integrated adapter accessory
Real-time Supercharger stall availability and preconditioning route planning in BMW Maps
Consolidated My BMW monthly charging billing for all commercial networks

sources.citation: G60-0771: 'Non-Tesla DC fast chargers are frequently broken or throttled. Seamless Plug & Charge at Superchargers is a must.'
US_2025 Study: 41% of US premium EV drivers cite public charging reliability as their primary ownership pain point.
Tesla Model S native Supercharging remains the gold standard for long-distance US EV usability.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Tesla Supercharger network opening fully standardized across all 50 US states by launch date.
Technical: 800V-to-400V high-voltage boost converter required when charging at older 400V Supercharger V3 stalls.

audit_trail.rationale: Critical requirement to eliminate US charging anxiety and match Tesla user experience.

requirements.title: Configurable Center Storage with 36oz Insulated Tumbler Clearance
requirements.smart_specification: Redesigned center console packaging offering dual spring-loaded modular cup holders engineered to secure up to 36oz (1.06L) insulated travel tumblers (98mm base diameter) without impinging on dual 15W Qi2 wireless charging cradles or center armrest actuation, combined with 12L split-opening under-armrest storage.
acceptance_criteria: Accommodates two 98mm diameter / 240mm tall insulated mugs simultaneously
Dual 15W Qi2 wireless phone chargers positioned clear of cup handles with active cooling
Center storage compartment volume ≥ 12 liters with illuminated USB-C 65W PD ports
Zero rattle or lateral container tipping during 0.8g emergency cornering maneuvers

sources.citation: G60-0215: 'Cup holders cannot comfortably fit large 32oz insulated travel mugs without blocking phone wireless charging pad.'
US_2025 Study: Practical storage ratings scored 12% lower than prior generation BMW 5 Series (G30).
Lucid Air and American luxury crossovers prioritize oversized multi-cup storage.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: American consumer preference for large insulated mugs remains an enduring cultural standard.
Spatial trade-off: Slight reduction in center console structural tunnel width offset by Neue Klasse flat-floor EV architecture.

audit_trail.rationale: Solves common US verbatim complaint regarding everyday ergonomics and phone charging interference.

requirements.title: Amap Lane-Level AR Guidance on BMW Panoramic Vision HUD
requirements.smart_specification: BMW Panoramic Vision full-windshield lower projection integrated with Amap (AutoNavi) lane-level navigation engine, projecting 3D photorealistic lane boundaries, elevated flyover fork indicators, and signalized intersection countdown timers with 10-meter virtual depth perception in Chinese mega-cities.
acceptance_criteria: Lane-level guidance accuracy ≤ 0.5 meters across complex multi-tier elevated highways
Refresh rate ≥ 60 Hz with latency ≤ 30 ms between vehicle GNSS positioning and HUD projection
Display of dynamic traffic light phase countdowns across 95% of Tier 1/2 Chinese intersections
Zero visual clutter: Projection automatically dims in high-density visual traffic zones

sources.citation: BMW Group Report 2025, p. 29: Navigation developed in collaboration with Amap provides precise visualization of complex intersections and highway ramps.
G60-0812: 'Missed highway exits in Shanghai flyovers because 2D screen map is hard to interpret at speed.'
XPENG XNGP and Huawei Qiankun ADS project detailed 3D environmental modeling.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Ongoing high-definition mapping data license partnership with Amap maintained.
Technical: Software co-developed with local BMW ConnectedDrive Lab in Shanghai.

audit_trail.rationale: Direct realization of BMW Annual Report p. 29 strategy uniting BMW Panoramic Vision and Amap lane-level software.

requirements.title: Rapid Pull-Down Active Seat Climate & Acupressure System
requirements.smart_specification: Next-generation multi-zone seat architecture featuring dual radial blower units per seat capable of dropping occupant contact surface temperature by ≥10°C within ≤90 seconds, maintaining quiet operation ≤40 dB(A) in Whisper Mode, integrated with 10-chamber pneumatic acupressure therapy.
acceptance_criteria: Contact surface temperature reduction ≥ 10°C in ≤ 90 seconds under 38°C cabin heat soak
Acoustic noise level ≤ 40 dB(A) in Whisper Mode at occupant ear level
Independent cushion and backrest airflow adjustment with moisture extraction mode
Weight optimization achieving ≤ 18.5 kg total seat frame mass per front seat

sources.citation: G60-0388: 'Seat cooling on hot summer days takes over 5 minutes to feel effective through perforated leather.'
G70-0001: Customer praised flagship heated/ventilated ergonomics, highlighting desire for similar performance on 5 Series.
XPENG G9 and Li Auto L8 offer rapid suction ventilation cooling occupants within 30-60 seconds.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: High summer cabin temperatures in Southern Europe, US Sunbelt, and Southern China make seat pull-down a key delight factor.
Material constraint: Perforated vegan Sensafin upholstery must maintain durability under high suction airflow.

audit_trail.rationale: Addresses significant thermal comfort delay complaints across G60 summer driving.

requirements.title: Thermally-Cooled Qi2 Wireless Phone Charging Cradle with 45W USB-C Fast-Charging
requirements.smart_specification: Active fan-cooled Qi2 magnetic wireless charging cradle in front center console that circulates quiet airflow beneath docked smartphone, maintaining device temperature below ≤38°C during simultaneous 15W wireless charging and wireless Apple CarPlay/Android Auto navigation, paired with dual 45W USB-C Power Delivery ports.
acceptance_criteria: Smartphone surface contact temperature stays ≤ 38°C after 60 mins continuous wireless charging
Zero thermal charging cutoffs or battery throttling warnings during summer navigation
Integrated 45W USB-C PD capable of fast-charging ultrabooks and tablets
Modular rubberized cradle insert accommodating iPhone Pro Max and Galaxy Ultra dimensions

sources.citation: F70-0142: 'Phone gets burning hot on the wireless charging tray and shuts down after 20 minutes of CarPlay.'
F70 customer satisfaction study: In-cabin practical ergonomics scored 8.46; wireless charging heat cited as top tech annoyance.
F70_OptionList.PDF: Wireless charging tray bundled with Comfort Package (SA 6NX).

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: 1 Series entry demographic relies >85% on smartphone projection over native navigation.
Acoustic Target: Micro-fan noise must stay under ≤28 dB(A) in quiet idle.

audit_trail.rationale: Direct solution to #1 tech complaint in F70 verbatims: smartphone overheating on wireless tray.

requirements.title: Compact Urban Automated Parking Assistant with 50m Reverse Memory
requirements.smart_specification: Advanced parking assistant optimized for tight European urban parking garages and parallel street spaces, executing automated parallel/perpendicular parking in gaps measuring vehicle length + 0.6m, with 50-meter automated reverse path tracking memory through narrow alleys.
acceptance_criteria: Executes autonomous parking in spaces with clearance as tight as vehicle length + 0.60m
Automated 50-meter reverse tracking accuracy ≤ 5 cm along original entry trajectory
Curb scuff protection utilizing 360° ultrasonic edge detection with automated wheel stop
Standard equipment across all European 1 Series trim lines

sources.citation: F70-0899: 'Parallel parking in Munich and Paris city centers is stressful without automatic curb distance alerts.'
sales_volumes.xlsx: 1 Series sells 80,000+ units annually in Europe, predominantly in high-density urban zones.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: European urban parking spaces continue to shrink relative to modern vehicle widths.
Hardware sharing: Utilizes standard camera and sensor suite from Neue Klasse entry zonal platform.

audit_trail.rationale: High-value feature for core European urban 1 Series demographic.

requirements.title: 31.3-inch 8K BMW Theatre Screen with Active Zero-Jitter Motion Stabilization
requirements.smart_specification: Roof-retractable 31.3-inch 8K panoramic OLED display (32:9 ratio) featuring active gyroscopic anti-jitter stabilization, eliminating screen oscillation during Autobahn cruising up to 160 km/h, paired with 36-speaker Bowers & Wilkins 4D Diamond Surround Sound with integrated headrest privacy sound zones.
acceptance_criteria: Screen oscillation amplitude limited to ≤ 1.5 mm at 140 km/h high-speed highway cruise
Deployment and fold-away duration ≤ 5.0 seconds with acoustic servo noise ≤ 26 dB(A)
Amazon Fire TV & native Chinese streaming apps (iQIYI, Tencent Video) with 5G multi-eSIM switching
Headrest-isolated private audio zones achieving ≥ 18 dB acoustic isolation between rear occupants

sources.citation: G70-0045: 'Theatre Screen is magnificent, but on slightly bumpy highways slight screen bounce causes eye fatigue over long movies.'
F70_G60_G68_G70_customer_studies.xlsx: G70 China overall satisfaction rated 9.64/10; rear entertainment cited as primary brand differentiator.
G70_OptionList.PDF: BMW Theatre Screen (SA 6FR) is signature flagship option.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: Ultra-high-net-worth buyers in China, US, and Middle East demand cinematic rear exclusivity.
Engineering: Roof structural cross-member reinforced with carbon fiber core to eliminate harmonic resonance.

audit_trail.rationale: Maintains 7 Series flagship supremacy against Mercedes-Maybach and Rolls-Royce rear entertainment.

requirements.title: Whisper-Silent Automated Servo Doors with Millimeter-Wave Obstacle Protection
requirements.smart_specification: Electrically actuated automatic opening and closing doors for all 4 positions operating with sound level ≤28 dB(A), integrated with wide-angle millimeter-wave radar in door sills preventing door contact with curbs, bollards, and passing cyclists with sub-2cm stopping accuracy.
acceptance_criteria: Door opening / closing servo motor sound level ≤ 28 dB(A)
Millimeter-wave obstacle detection range 0.1m to 2.5m with false-positive stop rate ≤ 1%
Automatic door brake reaction time ≤ 40 ms upon detecting approaching cyclist or vehicle
Gentle touch-to-open gesture sensor on exterior flush handle and keyless smartphone walk-up

sources.citation: G70-0211: 'Automatic doors occasionally refuse to open fully in tight Chinese parking spaces or stop too far from the curb.'
Rolls-Royce Spectre and Yangwang U8 feature intelligent power-assisted door articulation.

assumptions_uncertainties: Assumption: High proportion of chauffeur operation in Chinese Tier 1 luxury hotels and VIP lounges.
Cold Weather Reliability: Thermal heating elements prevent door seals from freezing in Northern China winter (-30°C).

audit_trail.rationale: Solves customer feedback on door obstruction sensitivity in Chinese dense parking environments.
